# Generated command sequence, mode A (wired uplink).
# Left column is applied in order; right column is the inverse recorded
# in the journal before the change is made.

## before the engine starts
do   nft -f -  <stdin: 10246 bytes, load the generated table; first line "# Caspian-BYOC generated firewall ruleset. Do not edit by hand:">
undo nft -f -  <stdin: 261 bytes, remove the generated table; first line "# Caspian-BYOC firewall teardown. The bare declaration makes the delete">
do   sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
undo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=0
do   sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2
undo sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=1
do   sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=2
undo sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=1
do   sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0
undo sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0
do   iw phy phy0 interface add ap0 type __ap
undo iw dev ap0 del
do   nmcli device set ap0 managed no
undo (none)
do   ip link set dev ap0 up
undo (none)
do   ip address add 10.83.51.1/24 dev ap0
undo ip address del 10.83.51.1/24 dev ap0
do   ip route add 203.0.113.10/32 via 192.168.1.1 dev eth0 proto static metric 5
undo ip route del 203.0.113.10/32 via 192.168.1.1 dev eth0 metric 5

## after the engine has created the tunnel device

undo ip address del 198.18.51.1/30 dev xray0

undo ip route del 10.83.51.0/24 dev ap0 table 8410
